text:
maria: Quick follow-up from INC-3245 postmortem. We agreed to add explicit triage steps for cache eviction during scale events, and to codify the escalation window (who to page and when) in the runbook. I sketched a minimal checklist below. Please claim items.

alex: I can own the checklist PR and the short diagnostics snippet.

rachel: Ill take alert tuning and PD escalation rules.

maria: Minimal "must-collect" on a page:
- pod logs (kubectl -n infra logs -l app=cache --since=30m)
- redis eviction metric snapshot (redwood-metrics query 'redis_evictions')
- pod resource snapshot (kubectl top pods -n infra)
- node alloc summary (kubectl describe node $NODE | grep -i alloc)

jon: Add a step to collect the autoscaler decision from controller logs: 
```
kubectl -n kube-system logs deploy/cluster-autoscaler --since=1h | grep -i scale
```

alex: For quick triage commands I want to add this verbatim to the checklist: 
```
# check for recent evictions
kubectl -n infra logs -l app=cache --tail=500 | egrep -i "evict|OOM|eviction"
# metric spike
redwood-metrics query 'increase(redis_evictions[5m])'
# inspect current pod sizing
kubectl top pods -n infra | sort -k3 -nr
```

maria: Good. Let's also include the ephemeral evidence bucket path pattern so oncall can upload tarballs: s3://redwood-incident-evidence/inc-3245/{{date}}/.

incidents-bot: New action: ACTION-4901 created (owner: alex) due 2277777200

alex: ACTION-4901: open PR to docs/triage/evictions.md with checklist & commands. Target EOD today.

rachel: ACTION-4902 created (owner: rachel) due 2277778000. Ill set PD escalation policy: page infra lead after 2 occurrences in 30 minutes; otherwise page oncall.

infra-bot: Note: autoscaler logs retention is 7d; consider increasing to 14d for recurring patterns.

maria: Long-term items: run a controlled scale test that reproduces eviction (jon+infra), and add an autoscaler canary that uses cgroup limits instead of overcommit. Assignments: jon will prototype test plan, alex will coordinate with infra for canary config.

jon: I'll draft a test plan by Mon and link it here. ACTION-4903 assigned to jon, due 2277830000.

oncall: When paged I'll run the three checklist commands and upload to the evidence bucket, then ping this thread.

alex: Reminder for PRs: include the ACTION numbers in the description and link to INC-3245 so the postmortem dashboard aggregates.

maria: Scheduling a 20m sync Thu to validate checklist landed and to confirm PD rules. If any owner needs more time, flag it here by EOD.

incidents-bot: ACTION-4901 status: in_progress (owner: alex); ACTION-4902 status: open (owner: rachel); ACTION-4903 status: open (owner: jon).
